objective_breakdown: Four contract metrics: ED>=327.18 Wh/kg (stage2, calc-energy contract caliber), SEI<=550 nm after 100 cycles @45C (stage2, aging_1C_100cyc_45C), no Li plating at 4C fast charge @45C (stage3, anode_potential_v min>=0), nail 10 W without thermal runaway (stage3, run-tr triggered=false). Trade-offs: ED vs plating/heat (thick low-porosity electrodes gain ED, hurt 4C margin), 45C SEI growth vs cycling temperature, nail safety vs cell thermal mass/cooling hA.
candidate_strategy: R1 baseline Chen2020 characterization (1C spme->dfn + calc-energy, 4C_charge_45C lumped+plating, aging_1C_100cyc_45C, run-tr nail 10 W with mass-kg and 4C-coupled t-init). R2 three architecture variants: HE-1 (thicker electrodes, thin CC/sep), HE-2 (lower porosity), HP-1 (plating-mitigation: thin negative, small neg particle, high-sigma electrolyte). R3+ targeted closure: SEI coating (SEI kinetic rate constant x0.1) if >550 nm; electrolyte transport overrides if plating; thermal management h_total if nail fails; escalate to Stage 2 material design (OKane2022 SiOx / LNMO switch) if ED unreachable in architecture space. Final integrated candidate re-verifies all four metrics.
budget_allocation: R1 baseline (1 round, 4 sim classes) + R2 architecture (3 candidates x 4 sims, spme quick-screen, dfn for passers) + R3-R5 targeted (2-3 candidates/round) + integrated final + nail checks; total est. 8-14 rounds; real_compute=false (default) -> no true DFT/MD endorsement.
risk_and_fallback: ED is hardest (baseline est. ~240 Wh/kg class; 327.18 needs ~+35% energy/mass). Nail physics: default hA~0.053 W/K cannot survive sustained 10 W -> cooling hA~0.9-1.5 W/K designed from cell geometry + HEV liquid cooling (plausible). SEI@45C likely >550 nm baseline -> coating x0.1 kinetics prepared (same-system comparison). Plating margin worsens with ED push -> negative particle size / electrolyte sigma / N-P levers. Three-strike protocol: question system/boundary/metric layers, prefer escalation (system switch) over negative close.
